title: demo_banner inlines the banner message; copy.demo_banner_message is defined but bypassed by its only consumer
detail: The diff's own comment says components never inline user-facing text, yet the banner ships a duplicate literal while the constant sits unused. Two copies of the same string will drift silently.
recommended_fix: Replace the inline literal in demo_banner.gleam's html.text with copy.demo_banner_message; delete the constant if the inline is intentional.

title: Applicant a-grace is 'Grace Kelly' in client fixtures but 'Gráinne Foley' in the baked PDF payloads, despite pdf_prebake claiming identical names
evidence:
client/src/demo/demo_fixtures.gleam (app_grace_json):
"first_name":"Grace","last_name":"Kelly","email":"grainne.foley@example.ie"

server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam (row_grace):
      "a-grace",
      "Gráinne",
      "Foley",
      "grainne.foley@example.ie",

payloads():
      application_id: "a-grace",
      applicant_name: "Gráinne Foley",

pdf_prebake.gleam header, same diff:
//// The applicant payloads below mirror the client fixture stories in
//// `client/src/demo/` (same names, incomes, scores, flags).
detail: The claimed mirroring is already broken: on-screen detail shows Grace Kelly, the downloaded report says Gráinne Foley. The client fixture's own email (grainne.foley@) contradicts its name too. Visible contradiction in the marketing demo.
recommended_fix: Pick one identity (name and matching email slug) for a-grace, update both demo_fixtures.gleam and pdf_prebake.gleam, and regenerate the PDF.

title: lint_demo_network.py guard check is a scope-unaware 35-line substring match that can mask unguarded api calls
evidence:
window = "\n".join(lines[max(0, idx - 35) : idx])
        guarded = "model.demo_mode" in window or "updated_model.demo_mode" in window
        if not guarded:
            violations.append(f"  client.gleam:{idx + 1}: {line.strip()} (scope: {arm_name})")
detail: The window is a raw 35-line slice: it can reach back across the arm boundary into a previous, already-guarded arm (or a comment merely mentioning model.demo_mode), so an api call in an adjacent unguarded arm passes the lint. Weakens the round-1 structural fix.
recommended_fix: Bound the window at the enclosing arm/fn boundary line already detected during scope resolution, so the demo_mode guard must appear within the same arm.

title: pdf_prebake.gleam imports three symbols it never uses
evidence:
import application/sql.{
  type GetApplicationDetailRow, type GetCoApplicantsByApplicationRow,
  type GetDocumentsByApplicationRow, type GetIncomeSourcesByApplicationRow,
  GetApplicationDetailRow, GetCoApplicantsByApplicationRow,
}
...
import gleam/result

(The snapshot uses only empty lists — documents: [], income_sources: [] — and no `result.` call appears anywhere in the 577-line module.)
detail: GetDocumentsByApplicationRow, GetIncomeSourcesByApplicationRow, and gleam/result are imported but unused; the compiler will emit warnings on every build of this module.
recommended_fix: Remove the two unused type imports and the gleam/result import from pdf_prebake.gleam.

title: pdf_prebake prints FAILED but exits 0, and swallows directory-creation errors
detail: On partial or total PDF failure the tool only prints FAILED and returns normally — exit code 0. A scripted regen can write nothing while appearing to succeed, committing stale report assets unnoticed.
recommended_fix: Halt with a non-zero exit status when failures > 0, and fail fast when create_directory_all errors instead of discarding it.

title: decode_checked and all_fixture_jsons are documented as conformance-suite helpers, but the suite never references them; all_fixture_jsons duplicates the seed array assembly
detail: The named consumer demonstrably doesn't consume them, and the duplicated array assembly means the drift-guard list can silently diverge from what the store actually seeds.
recommended_fix: Either make the conformance suite enumerate all_fixture_jsons (replacing the duplicated assembly) or delete both helpers.

title: CI demo lint bans api_helpers/rsvp/fetch in demo/ but not real api-module imports, despite claiming 'no API/network imports in demo/'
evidence:
VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rn "api_helpers" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" || true)
          RSVP_VERBS=$(grep -rnE "rsvp\\.(send|get|post|put|patch|delete)" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" || true)
          FETCH_VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rln "gleam/fetch" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" | grep -v "demo_api.gleam" || true)
...
          echo "Demo mode is fully client-side: no API/network imports in demo/, no unguarded api calls in client.gleam."
detail: A demo module importing api/vacancy_api (whose own code performs the network I/O) passes all three greps — the rsvp calls live outside demo/. The echoed invariant is broader than what's enforced.
recommended_fix: Add a fourth grep banning `import api/` in client/src/demo/, mirroring API_MODULES in lint_demo_network.py.

title: Marta's baked report carries five category scores where all seven other payloads carry six (rental_history omitted, unmarked)
evidence:
a-marta:
      category_scores: "{\"income_affordability\":86,\"employment_stability\":82,\"reference_verification\":76,\"application_completeness\":90,\"red_flag_detection\":80}",

a-aoife (same list, for contrast):
      category_scores: "{\"income_affordability\":92,\"employment_stability\":88,\"rental_history\":85,\"reference_verification\":90,\"application_completeness\":95,\"red_flag_detection\":84}",
detail: Seven of eight payloads include rental_history; Marta's omits it with no comment marking the omission deliberate. If the Typst template or client store assumes a fixed category set, her PDF renders inconsistent with the rest.
recommended_fix: Add rental_history to Marta's payload or leave a comment at the payload documenting the deliberate omission for the first-time-renter story.
